close.title: Close the group
close.hint: Closing freezes the group: no more joining, invitations, posts or moderation, and its posts are no longer shown. Closing is final; archiving and deletion remain possible.

archive.hint: Archiving closes the group and removes it from discovery, without deleting anything. Archiving is final; deletion remains possible.

delete.title: Delete the group
delete.hint: Deletion permanently erases the group, its rules, its posts with their reactions, comments and media, its members and its invitations. It cannot be undone.
